messages:
violet: Field ask summary: two customers require an offline-friendly 'preserve-network' upgrade mode that never reassigns their CIDRs or peering IPs. Need decision and owners.

sam: Short proposal: add opt-in manifest flag `network.preserve: true`. Installer will persist allocation metadata to a PV or external KV and skip any automatic rebinds.

ori: Implementation notes: - add `--preserve-network` to installer - migration job to reattach peer IPs/certs after upgrade - preflight that fails on CIDR overlap (clear remediation) - audit events for reserve/release.

violet: Launch criteria draft: 1) installer accepts `network.preserve` + reserved_ranges, 2) preflight implemented, 3) migration job + `--retain-network-state`, 4) runbook + rollback steps, 5) one pilot (offline-capable customer) complete.

sam: SLA note: preserve lane is opt-in and may require an operator window (15-30m). Default lane SLOs unchanged. Add telemetry opt-in snippet for post-upgrade verification.

ops-bot: Pilot scheduled: 2026-12-08 09:00 UTC. Invite sent to violet, sam, ori. :calendar:

violet: Action items: sam -> PR for installer flag + preflight (due Fri). ori -> migration playbook + telemetry text (due Tue). I'll consolidate launch criteria after pilot.

sam: If pilot shows heavy manual steps, we ship preserve lane as opt-in alpha and iterate. Agreed?

ori: Agreed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
